# Vendored third-party assets

## codemirror/ — CodeMirror 5.65.16

Fetched via `npm pack codemirror@5.65.16` (through the corporate proxy)
on 2026-07-05. CodeMirror 5 is used (not 6) because it needs no bundler:
the two core files load directly with plain `<script>`/`<link>` tags.

Files (copied verbatim from the npm tarball):
- `codemirror/codemirror.js`      (package/lib/codemirror.js)
- `codemirror/codemirror.css`     (package/lib/codemirror.css)
- `codemirror/mode/mllike/mllike.js` (package/mode/mllike/mllike.js — OCaml/ML syntax mode)
- `codemirror/LICENSE`            (MIT)
